title: Towards Guaranteed Optimal PID Tuning for Uncertain Nonlinear Systems
summary: Despite the widespread use of PID controllers in engineering practice, designing optimal PID parameters has long been regarded as a challenging problem in both theory and practice, particularly when faced with uncertain nonlinear dynamical systems. Based on the authors' PID control theory established recently for MIMO nonlinear uncertain systems (Zhao and Guo, 2022), which provides a concrete PID parameter set for global stability of PID controlled systems, this paper further proposes a near-optimal PID tuning method, where only input-output (zeroth-order) data on the control performance is…
